kPEPE.note: Danny 29 Oct: NO half-take, let it run to TP

lessons: ONE BET, NOT THREE (from BTC/ENA/ZEC, 22 Oct, 3 losses). Alt longs plus BTC long opened together = one correlated BTC bet at ~15% risk. When BTC is the driver, max 2 open longs total until one is at breakeven, and at most 1 new entry per run unless the coins are genuinely uncorrelated.

BTC GATE SCRAPPED BY DANNY (28 Oct 2026). Do NOT block alt longs on BTC structure. Every alt trades on its own chart: own 4h higher low / breakout hold, rising OI, $5M+ vol. BTC context is only a note (if BTC is actively dumping, a 4h close breaking down hard, skip fresh entries that run). Check Danny's X list EVERY run.

NO CHASING THE GREEN-BOARD DAY (same 3 losses). After a board-wide +10-30% day, don't buy "retests" right into it at the open of the next session. Wait for a real pullback that holds (higher low printed on 4h) before entering.

BREAKOUT-HOLD LONGS ARE 0/4 (BTC, ENA, ZEC 22 Oct; HYPE 28 Oct). Buying after a few 4h closes above a fresh breakout keeps getting faded back into the range. Only take a breakout long after price has actually retested the level (4h wick into it) and closed back above, or buy the next 4h higher low after that retest. Trail stops under a higher low with a buffer (~0.3-0.5x ATR), not a few ticks under it.
